description:
Return a queued owned-job receipt (data.job_id and data.status). Read the exact id through job_service.get_job for the complete former response in job.result or the typed failure in job.error. Admission retains payload references locally; uncertain effects require reconciliation and must never be replayed automatically.

Summarize weak episodic memories into semantic memories. Part of memory lifecycle - compresses old, unused memories.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: The complete memory-operation response from the exact admitted job; the immediate response is a queued job receipt.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Consolidating weak episodic memories into semantic memories
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: InferenceError: failed to generate summaries for memory clusters. EmbeddingError: failed to generate embeddings for consolidated memories. DatabaseError: failed to update memory records.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For inference errors: verify inference service is available. For embedding errors: verify embedding service is available. For database errors: verify state and vector storage are accessible.
